details:
--- Summary ---

My public world cannot be entered since my last two uploads. The uploads succeed in the SDK, but when I join, the client gets HTTP 403 "File forbidden" from the server-side security analysis endpoint for the new file versions and refuses to download the world. An earlier file version of the same world loaded fine the day before, so this is not my account or network. Fully reproducible, on hidden and normal instances, in both eu and jp regions.

--- Affected world/files ---

World: Edinburgh 爱丁堡 (public)

World ID: wrld_43e3aa77-3777-41b4-8b8a-c052103d3ea7

File ID : file_041aafa7-760c-488a-87a4-099a5772a5ca

Author : Xiaobooo (usr_4a0dac23-0ff6-4d9e-b3dc-cfe17d871db8)

- version 6 (852 MB, uploaded 2026-10-24) -> loads fine

- version 7 (686 MB, created 2026-10-25 00:26) -> rejected (403), still rejected over an hour later

- version 8 (1,062 MB, uploaded 2026-10-25 around 02:31-02:34 local time) -> rejected (403)

All file versions upload with status "complete".

--- Client log ---

2026.10.25 02:38:55 Error - [API] [247, 403, Get, -1 https://api.vrchat.cloud/api/1/analysis/file_041aafa7-760c-488a-87a4-099a5772a5ca/8/security] Abandoning request, because - File forbidden

2026.10.25 02:38:55 Error - World 'wrld_43e3aa77-3777-41b4-8b8a-c052103d3ea7' did not pass initial checks and won't be downloaded: 10

2026.10.25 02:38:55 Error - Object reference not set to an instance of an object. (NullReferenceException in AssetPreloader)

The same 403 appears for .../analysis/file_041aafa7-760c-488a-87a4-099a5772a5ca/7/security (hundreds of times, from 01:02 onward).

--- Client / environment ---

Client: VRChat Build 2026.4.1-1935-a61ceb9d89-Release (Steam, PC)

Client Unity: 6000.0.67f1-DWR

OS: Windows 11

World authoring: Unity 2022.3.22f1

SDK: com.vrchat.base / com.vrchat.worlds 3.10.4

Platform: PC / Windows (standalonewindows)

--- What I have already checked ---

- The world record is not deleted or private: it is public and still has the "system_approved" tag.

- Version 7 is smaller than version 6, so file size alone does not explain it.

- The upload itself completes (file, signature, and world update all succeed in the SDK).

--- Request ---

Please check the server-side analysis result for file_041aafa7-760c-488a-87a4-099a5772a5ca versions 7 and 8 and tell me what the scanner flagged, or whether this is a false positive. If needed, please roll the world back to version 6. I can provide the full client log and the Unity Editor.log.
title: World rejected by server-side analysis (403 "File forbidden"): latest two file versions of my public world cannot be entered, earlier version works
